annotations.title: P-Video Replace: swap the person in a video

description: Put the person from your pictures into an existing video in place of the one there, keeping the motion, scene and sound. 720p, as long as the source. Compared with other video tools: budget. Price: from $0.041 per second (one call: from $0.204 per video), charged only on success. Price depends on max_seconds: 5 $0.204, 10 $0.406, 15 $0.609, 20 $0.811 (default 5). With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per second), never more than this price. One call = one short video.

images.description: 1 to 3 pictures of the person to place into the video (https URLs). Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

instruction_prompt.description: Optional: who replaces whom, or other placement notes

max_seconds.description: Longest the source video can be; sets the price. Longer videos are refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 5

video.description: Source video as an MP4 link (https); the result is as long as this video. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)
